name: Buzzbar
author: Jon Bolt
description: Unread across your Buzz channels and DMs, with a click through to the app.

barWidget.description: Unread channels and DMs, and a jump into Buzz

schema.label: Show the count
schema.description: The number beside the glyph counts DMs and mentions, not everything unread — a number that ticks up for every message in every busy channel is a number you stop reading. Off leaves the glyph alone, which still changes colour.

schema.label: Check every
schema.description: Seconds between reads of the Buzz cache. The read is a few milliseconds against a local file and never touches the network, so this is cheap; it is here because how quickly you want to be told varies more than the cost does.
